season.evidence: Mountaineers lists May-July; SummitPost-type page says May to October reasonable; reports advise going early so snow covers the Swamp Creek brush; histogram peaks May-Jul (21/30/30). Stored Jun-Jul.

track.why: Only one route is stored on this peak. Track is a 2019-07-14 round trip from High Bridge (start 143 m, end 112 m from our trailhead pin) via Hemlock Camp and Dark Fin Col to the Dark Glacier and summit (16 m from our pin or less), matching the Hemlock/Dark Fin Col variant described in our approach text. Sparse (514 pts) but complete.

facts.text: In early May the Agnes Creek section of the PCT was cleared by trail crews only as far as 1-2 miles short of Swamp Creek camp, after which about 30 trees lay across the tread; the camp itself was snow free that month in a low-snow year.
In early May the shuttle bus beyond Stehekin is not yet running on its regular schedule, so a private ride to High Bridge has to be arranged ahead.
In early June the key log over Swamp Creek sits lower than usually described, below the first talus field, and the old trail bed helps avoid the worst slide alder.
By mid-July the glacier is soft and mushy; falling ice and debris from the cirque walls cross the traverse, so keep moving through that stretch.
Via Hemlock Camp, go straight uphill through forest, brush and deadfall to about 5,600 ft, then loose talus to 6,000 ft, then drop steep dirt to the glacier; the return through the forest is slow.
Open bivouac sites at Dark Fin Col are scarce, and meltwater is found at the foot of the far side of the col.
Early May slab avalanche risk on the deep snow slopes just below Dark Fin Col; one climber was swept 60 ft there.

notes: Single-route peak. The 2025-06-29 'West Approach' log and the Lyman Lakes SW route (Oct) are alternate approaches not in our catalog. Camp name Cedar Camp is a stored pin elsewhere (Fivemile Camp) - not proposed.
